title: Evening Brief — Wed 25 Nov

stories.board: Dow wipes out 1,100-point drop, ends up
stories.headline: Big comeback on Wall Street before Thanksgiving
stories.what: The Dow was down more than 1,100 points during the day but finished up 0.33 percent. The Nasdaq (a list of mostly tech companies) still ended down 0.62 percent.
stories.why: Worries about prices, AI spending and new tariffs (extra taxes on imports) are making markets jumpy. US markets are closed Thursday.
stories.sides: No major disagreement on the numbers; reports agree energy stocks led the bounce while tech stayed weak.

stories.board: US jury finds Huawei guilty of stealing secrets
stories.headline: Chinese tech giant Huawei convicted in US court
stories.what: A US jury found Huawei guilty of conspiracy (secretly planning together) to steal American trade secrets, and of bank fraud. It was found not guilty of racketeering (running a crime ring).
stories.why: It is a big win for the US in its tech fight with China, which already has tense trade ties.
stories.sides: Right-leaning Fox Business stresses the theft and breaking Iran sanctions (rules banning trade); CBC and others stress that some charges did not stick.

stories.board: Eisenkot aims to swear in government next week
stories.headline: Israel's Eisenkot bloc says a new government is close
stories.what: Gadi Eisenkot's group plans to swear in a government next week with 61 seats, after Avigdor Liberman agreed to join. The Knesset (Israel's parliament) also took a first step on a term limit for prime ministers and an October 7 inquiry.
stories.why: It could end Netanyahu's long time as prime minister.
stories.sides: Eisenkot's side calls it a fix for democracy; Likud says the term-limit bill is aimed at Netanyahu. Yair Golan's party and Shas are still not on board.

quick_hits: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says more oil tankers hit sea mines near the Strait of Hormuz; this has not been confirmed by others.
Israel's Defence Minister Katz says Iran is building chemical weapons and Israel will not allow it.
US stock markets are closed Thursday for American Thanksgiving and close early Friday.
big_picture: A shaky but calm finish for markets, a big US court win against Huawei, and Israel may get a new leader soon.
